_meta.purpose: Held-out test set. Any classifier is scored against this BEFORE being run on the other 251 breweries.
_meta.note: Corey answered in natural language, not in our tags — that mismatch is itself a finding (see taxonomyGaps). Mappings below are our translation of his words; where his phrasing has no tag, it is recorded in `unmapped` rather than silently dropped. `raw` always preserves his exact words, so every translation here is auditable against it.
taxonomyGaps: RESOLVED 2026-08-17 — non-alcoholic, kolsch and amber-red are now StyleTags; easyDrinking and experimental are now TASTE_AXES. All `unmapped` entries below have been translated into them.
OPEN — 'old school' (True History) is still carried only as raw text. It reads as a stance rather than a style or an axis, and one instance is not enough to model.
retranslated: godspeed and true-history previously listed `pale-ale` in goFor. Neither raw answer mentions a pale ale — `pale-ale` was the stand-in for kölsch back when kölsch folded into it. With `kolsch` now its own tag, the stand-in is removed and the real tag used. This makes the test set stricter, not looser.
steam-whistle's 'not: Experimental beers' and halo's 'experimental brews' are the same axis pointing opposite ways. Recorded as axes, not styles.

badlands.raw: IPAs, barrel aged stouts / not: Lagers, Sours

godspeed.raw: Czech style lagers, pilsners, kolsh with japanese infusion / not: IPAs, stouts

rorschach.raw: IPAs, weird style sours, heavy stouts, refreshing lagers/pilsners

great-lakes.raw: Lagers, ales, IPAs, but really anything

henderson.raw: Ales, easy drinking beers / not: Sours

true-history.raw: Old school beers, lagers, pilsners, ambers, kolshs / not: IPAs, Sours
